query: How can support teams reduce ticket resolution time?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Categorising free-text descriptions into issue types gives a strong grouping axis to compare resolution_minutes across category types, directly serving the query. However groundedness is undermined by clear misreads: CS-0004 (a feature enhancement request) labelled 'billing', and CS-0005 (a CSV/BOM export bug, likely data/integration) labelled 'outage'. Several samples are correct (billing, auth, outage), but the error rate on the visible sample is material.

per_column.name: estimated_complexity
per_column.rationale: A complexity tier is a reasonable inferential axis that can help explain and model resolution time. Values are mostly defensible warranted inferences (outage=high, simple enhancement=low). It is inherently subjective but the samples are plausible readings of the text, so groundedness is moderately high.

per_column.name: routing_recommendation
per_column.rationale: Routing directly speaks to the query—correct routing reduces resolution time—so it is a useful actionable axis. But it is largely derived from issue_category and inherits its errors: CS-0004 routed to billing specialist (it is a product feature request), and CS-0005 escalated as if an outage. When category is right (auth->security, outage->escalate) routing is sound, but the propagated misreads lower groundedness.

per_column.name: self_service_candidate
per_column.rationale: A binary self-service flag is a plausible lever for reducing ticket load and time, so it has some analytical value, though it is coarser and partly redundant with complexity. Groundedness is weak: CS-0001 (a duplicate-invoice correction needing a human-issued corrected invoice) marked 'yes', and CS-0004 (a product feature request that cannot be self-served) marked 'yes' are poorly supported by the text.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide genuine new analytical axes (issue type, complexity, routing, self-service) that let an analyst group and model resolution_minutes and identify levers to reduce resolution time—well aligned with the query and not merely redundant with existing columns. However groundedness is only moderate: the visible samples show real misclassifications (feature request tagged billing, export bug tagged outage, an invoice correction and a feature request tagged self-service 'yes'), and these errors propagate into routing_recommendation. The columns are useful in principle but their values are not reliably faithful to the source text.
